newsitem.title: UK: More O'Ferrall buys US advertising firm.
newsitem.headline: More O'Ferrall buys US advertising firm.

text.p: Outdoor advertising group More O'Ferrall Plc said it is buying SHF Communications Inc, the New York based street furniture advertising firm for $3.9 million in cash and $600,000 in shares in its More Group Inc subisidiary.
More O'Ferrall said the deal marked further international expansion of its Adshel brand in major markets.

SHF, which will change its name to Adshel, had sales of $2.2 million for the year to December 31 1995 and pretax profits of $300,000. Net assets at the year end were $500,000. SHF has contracts with Westchester County in New York and Palm Beach County, Florida and operates 650 bus shelter advertising panels.
Stephen Feinberg, who founded SHF in 1992, will stay on as chief executive of Adshel Inc.

Roger Parry, chief executive of More O'Farrell, said the deal would enhance earnings per share and cash flow from Adshel Inc would help the group finance applications for street furniture advertising contracts in the U.S. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
